text:
Detective:
Ok, got it. That should be about half of the investigation completed...

Detective:
(Can't wait to go home soon... I have to catch up on my sleep.)

Doubt:
(How am I so sure? There could be a lot more work ahead of me...)

Detective:
(...I haven't checked everything yet, but it shouldn't take too much longer...)

Doubt:
(CHECK IT AGAIN. THERE'S MORE HERE.)

Detective:
(I need to stop thinking about this and move onto the rest of the scene.)

Doubt:
(DO YOUR JOB CORRECTLY. INVESTIGATE THOROUGHLY. CHECK AND CHECK AND CHECK-)

Detective:
(...Just focus on the notebook. Cut through the noise.)
*Detective begins writing in their notebook, reading aloud as they go.*

Detective:
Investigation is running smoothly. I'm about halfway through. I'm tired, and my head hurts... But I have made more progress than I thought I would. I can finish this job.
